description: Real-time authorization of about 37.8 million transactions a day for Merchant Acquiring merchants through the authorization switch, terminal gateway, e-commerce gateway, and enterprise merchant gateway
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants cannot take cards within minutes of an outage; large merchants fail over to backup processors and may not return; 99.99% monthly availability commitment (about 4.3 minutes a month); critical infrastructure service
manual_workaround: Stand-in processing by the card networks for some issuers within network limits; enterprise merchants with store-and-forward terminals queue offline transactions under their own floor limits; no manual workaround at scale
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-07; SYS-10 (network links); Cloud A two regions
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; card networks; payment HSM vendor; telecommunications carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Authorization platform engineers; Cyber Fusion Center; network operations center
quantified_impact_basis: About 31 million lost authorizations a day at about $0.24 average net revenue ($7.4 million) plus about $4.2 million in service credits under merchant agreements
bank_covered_service: Yes (Banks A, B, C): authorization processing is a covered service in all three sponsor agreements
single_points_of_failure: Single cloud provider for Merchant Acquiring authorization (two regions active-active)

description: Issue and detokenize tokens for recurring billing, card-on-file merchants, and ISV partners; about 9 million detokenization requests a day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Recurring billing and card-on-file transactions fail without detokenization; vault integrity is essential because tokens cannot be re-created
manual_workaround: Queue recurring billing runs for retry; no manual detokenization
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; payment HSM vendor
quantified_impact_basis: About 22% of card-not-present volume is token-based; lost fees plus retry and service credit cost
single_points_of_failure: Single token vault cluster (replicated across two regions)

business_process: E-commerce gateway and hosted payment pages
description: Card-not-present payments through the e-commerce gateway, hosted payment pages, and embedded payment forms for about 140,000 e-commerce merchants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: E-commerce checkouts fail immediately; merchants switch gateways; payment page integrity duties (PCI DSS 6.4.3, 11.6.1)
manual_workaround: Merchants with a secondary gateway fail over on their side; status page and merchant notices
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-04; SYS-08 (tamper-detection); content delivery service
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; content delivery service
quantified_impact_basis: About 42% of Merchant Acquiring card volume is card-not-present; lost fees plus service credits
single_points_of_failure: Single content delivery service for hosted payment pages

business_process: Clearing file submission to the card networks
description: Build and send clearing files for each network before its daily cutoff; files carry full PAN
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Settlement and Treasury Operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Network cutoffs once a day per network; late presentment causes interchange downgrades and delays merchant funding by a day
manual_workaround: Hold and resubmit the next cycle; network exception processing for very large files
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (clearing file builder); SYS-10 (network interface processors and MFT); SYS-03
dependent_third_parties: Card networks; MFT software vendor; DC-1 and DC-2 facilities
dependent_people_or_facilities: Settlement operations (about 140 operators on shifts); mainframe engineers
quantified_impact_basis: Interchange downgrades and late presentment cost on about $2.1 billion of daily volume, plus one-day funding delay costs
bank_covered_service: Yes (Banks A, B, C): clearing is a covered service
single_points_of_failure: MFT appliances (one vendor) on the clearing path; single mainframe in DC-1 (DR in DC-2)

business_process: Merchant funding file generation and delivery to the sponsor banks
description: Build merchant funding ACH files and send them to Banks A, B, and C before each bank's daily cutoff; about $2.1 billion of merchant funding a business day
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Settlement and Treasury Operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bank cutoffs (Bank A 03:00, Bank B 04:00, Bank C 05:00 Eastern); a missed cutoff delays funding for hundreds of thousands of merchants; a 4-hour disruption of covered services triggers bank service provider notices (12 CFR 53.4; 304.24; 225.303)
manual_workaround: Re-send the prior validated file plus a delta file; banks can hold their ACH window open by agreement for up to 2 hours; manual funding of the top 300 enterprise merchants by wire
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (funding file generation); SYS-10 (MFT and treasury workstations); SYS-03
dependent_third_parties: Banks A, B, and C; MFT software vendor; DC-1 and DC-2 facilities
dependent_people_or_facilities: Settlement operations; treasury operations; mainframe engineers
quantified_impact_basis: Advance funding and overdraft cost of about $0.6 million a day plus about $1.5 million in merchant service credits; severe regulatory and reputational effect after one missed cutoff
bank_covered_service: Yes (Banks A, B, C): merchant funding file services are covered services
single_points_of_failure: MFT appliances; single settlement platform (DR in DC-2 not proven within RTO)

business_process: Settlement reconciliation, interchange, and fee calculation
description: Reconcile network settlement against clearing, calculate interchange and merchant fees, and post to the general ledger
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Settlement and Treasury Operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Funding can proceed on prior-day positions for one cycle; unreconciled positions after 24 hours create settlement risk with the banks; SOX-relevant
manual_workaround: Fund on validated network settlement totals and reconcile afterward with dual approval
dependent_third_parties: Card networks; Banks A, B, C
quantified_impact_basis: Rework and settlement exposure; misstatement risk at quarter-end
bank_covered_service: Yes (Banks A, B, C): reconciliation is a covered service

business_process: Integrated Payments API and hosted payment fields (SL-1)
description: Authorization and tokenization through partner APIs and hosted payment fields embedded in about 2,600 ISV software platforms
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ISV partners' checkouts fail; 99.95% contractual availability; ISVs can move merchants to other processors
manual_workaround: Status page; partners queue card-on-file charges for retry; no manual path for card-present
dependent_systems: SYS-05 (Cloud B); SYS-03 (cloud payment HSM service); SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Cloud B provider; card networks; ISV partners
quantified_impact_basis: About $1.1 billion of annual revenue (about $3.0 million a day) plus service credits
bank_covered_service: Yes (Bank B): authorization processing for Bank B's Integrated Payments program
single_points_of_failure: Single cloud provider (Cloud B) for Integrated Payments

description: Instant and same-day payouts of settled funds to merchants' debit cards and bank accounts; licensed money transmission, including in New York
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants rely on same-day access to funds; licensed activity with NYDFS oversight; depends on settlement outputs from SYS-02
manual_workaround: Switch payouts to next-day standard funding through the sponsor banks; notify merchants
dependent_third_parties: Cloud B provider; instant payment and card push-payment networks; Bank C
quantified_impact_basis: About $210 million of annual revenue (about $0.58 million a day); merchant attrition after repeated failures

description: Receive, research, and respond to about 48,000 chargebacks a day through network dispute systems
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Network response windows are measured in days; missed windows shift liability to the company or merchants
manual_workaround: Work disputes from network portals directly; prioritize by amount and deadline
dependent_systems: SYS-02 (chargeback system); SYS-04 (merchant portal); AI-004 drafting assistant
quantified_impact_basis: Liability for disputes not answered in time (about $350,000 a day at current volumes)
bank_covered_service: Yes (Banks A, B, C): chargeback handling supports covered services

description: Score every authorization for fraud in real time and run merchant risk monitoring
process_owner: Senior Vice President, Fraud and Risk Management
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Fallback rules in the switch keep authorizations flowing but raise fraud losses and false declines within hours; model artifacts change at most daily
manual_workaround: Fallback velocity and amount rules in the authorization switch (activated automatically); analysts tighten rules for high-risk merchant categories
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; consortium fraud data feed
quantified_impact_basis: Higher fraud losses and false declines under fallback rules (about $1.8 million a day)
single_points_of_failure: Model serving cluster in Cloud A (two regions)

business_process: Merchant and partner portals, virtual terminal, and reporting
description: Merchant self-service, virtual terminal key-entry, funding account maintenance, statements, and reporting for about 1.1 million users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants can operate without the portal for a day; virtual terminal users lose key-entry; funding account changes pause (a fraud control benefit)
manual_workaround: Contact center handles urgent requests with call-back verification; statements regenerated later
dependent_third_parties: Cloud A provider; content delivery service
quantified_impact_basis: Virtual terminal volume and support surge cost

description: Application intake, identity verification, underwriting decisions (AI-002 score), and boarding of about 9,000 new merchants a month
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New merchants can wait a few days; sponsor bank and network underwriting standards must still be met
manual_workaround: Queue applications; manual underwriting for priority partners
dependent_third_parties: Onboarding and KYC SaaS provider; identity verification vendor; merchant risk scoring vendor

description: Inbound calls, chat, and tickets for merchants and partners (about 85,000 contacts a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants need help immediately during any processing incident; call recordings may hold spoken card data (gap)
manual_workaround: Route calls to the backup carrier and overflow vendor; status page and outbound messages
dependent_third_parties: Contact center SaaS provider; telephony carriers; overflow vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Agent idle time, overflow cost, and merchant attrition

business_process: Treasury and sponsor bank cash management
description: Settlement account funding, intraday liquidity, and reserve account management with Banks A, B, and C
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily settlement obligations to the networks; reserve requirements in sponsor agreements
manual_workaround: Bank portals and phone instructions with call-back verification
quantified_impact_basis: Liquidity cost and late settlement penalties
single_points_of_failure: Treasury workstations in DC-1 (standby in DC-2)

description: Quarterly and annual close, SOX controls, and Form 10-Q and 10-K preparation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; MTD drops to 48 hours during the quarter-end close window
manual_workaround: Extend the close calendar; manual journal entries with dual approval
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and audit fees; a late filing would be Severe

description: Biweekly payroll for 12,000 employees (about $44 million a run); SOX-relevant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll cutoff is 72 hours before pay date; wage payment laws
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll with adjustments through the payroll provider
quantified_impact_basis: Manual adjustments and penalties if payroll is late

business_process: Data, analytics, and merchant reporting feeds
description: Data lake and warehouse feeds for merchant reporting, network reporting, and analytics
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reporting can lag a few days; network reports are monthly or quarterly
manual_workaround: Regenerate reports from settlement data after recovery

description: ISV partner certification, sandbox, and developer documentation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New partner integrations can wait; existing partners unaffected
manual_workaround: Pause certifications; share documentation by email
